name: ryu.agentbrowser
description: Browser automation via the `agent-browser` CLI's MCP server (https://agent-browser.dev). Provides the swappable `browser.control` layer, recording tools, and the documented localhost live stream, so selecting it re-points the stable `browser.*` tools at agent-browser without changing what agents call. Launched via `npx agent-browser mcp --tools all`; needs Node on PATH.

agentbrowser.description: Agent Browser — browser automation, recording, and screenshot tools over MCP. Launched via `npx -y agent-browser mcp --tools all`; unavailable until Node is installed and the package can be fetched.
